item.title: 'Save your tears': White House's response to Ariana Grande’s anti-Trump voter message; credits Trump for ending Biden’s inflation crisis
item.description: The White House issued a fiery clapback to singer Ariana Grande after she reposted an anti-Trump message criticizing his 2024 voters. White House spokesperson Kush Desai used Grande's song titles to claim President Trump ended inflation and addressed Ticketmaster issues. Grande's original repost questioned if Trump supporters' lives improved amidst societal challenges.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Vance predicts shutdown as White House talks fail; slams Democrats
item.description: A federal government shutdown looms after White House talks failed, with funding set to expire Wednesday. Democrats demand extending Affordable Care Act tax credits, while Republicans accuse them of holding the government hostage by blocking a "clean" resolution. This stalemate over healthcare protections makes a last-minute breakthrough unlikely, threatening widespread service disruptions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Israel is losing information war’: Charlie Kirk’s letter to Netanyahu — Details
item.description: Assassinated conservative activist Charlie Kirk wrote to Benjamin Netanyahu, warning Israel was "losing the information war" and facing declining support, even among conservatives. His letter, now fully revealed, urged a communications intervention, proposing rapid response teams, an "Israel Truth Network," and strategic messaging using released hostages to counter anti-Israel sentiment.

item.title: Watch: ICE agents chase a food delivery rider in Chicago; netizens have a field day
item.description: A viral video shows ICE agents unsuccessfully chasing a food delivery rider through downtown Chicago after he allegedly made verbal comments. The 17-second clip sparked varied online reactions, from mocking ICE's fitness to praising the rider's escape skills, further fueling debates on immigration enforcement.

item.title: Pro-life influencer who got sucker-punched in viral street interview fears more attacks
item.description: Conservative pro-life influencer Savannah Craven Antao described a violent street attack, attributing her facial injuries to escalating left-wing aggression. The assailant's criminal case was dismissed due to a DA oversight, prompting Craven Antao to pursue a civil lawsuit and remain committed to her advocacy against political violence.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump says shutdown ‘a possibility’; warns Democrats of political price
item.description: US President Donald Trump warns of a government shutdown. He blames Democrats for the funding stalemate. A Monday meeting with congressional leaders is scheduled. Trump sees a shutdown as an opportunity for cuts. Democrats want to protect healthcare subsidies. Republicans link talks to immigration issues. Both sides remain unwilling to compromise.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Think they are doing that’: Trump suggests DOJ may probe Christopher Wray
item.description: Donald Trump suggested the Justice Department investigate former FBI Director Christopher Wray, accusing him of "inappropriate" conduct. Trump cited a claim of 274 plainclothes FBI agents at the Jan 6 Capitol riot, despite evidence to the contrary. This follows Trump's repeated calls for investigations into political adversaries, reinforcing his belief in directing the DOJ against perceived enemies.

item.title: 'Historic day': Israel agrees to Trump's 20-point Gaza peace plan, Netanyahu will 'finish the job' if Hamas rejects
item.description: Trump's 20-point peace plan for Gaza: Gaza will be deradicalized, terror-free zone and all hostages, alive or dead, will be returned. Trump will lead a Board of Peace and a temporary government will take over Gaza. If Hamas does not reject the plan, Israel will "finish the job" and it will have Trump's full backing.

item.title: Man City midfield star Bernardo Silva tempted by £500k-a-week Saudi offer: Will he make the jump?
item.description: Manchester City's midfield linchpin, Bernardo Silva, 31, is reportedly weighing a monumental £500,000-per-week offer from Saudi club Al Hilal. As Saudi Arabia aggressively pursues its 2026 football vision by targeting Portuguese icons, Silva faces a career-defining choice between European elite football and a lucrative final contract that could significantly shape the burgeoning Saudi Pro League.

item.title: Ship struck in Gulf of Aden: Suspected missile sets vessel ablaze off Yemen coast; Houthi role suspected
item.description: A vessel caught fire in the Gulf of Aden on Monday. A suspected missile strike caused the incident. Houthi rebels likely launched the projectile from Yemen. Initial reports indicated no casualties. This attack follows previous Houthi actions. They target vessels in the Red Sea. This disrupts maritime trade. The incident coincides with Gaza operations.

item.title: World’s tallest bridge standing at 625m: Huajiang Grand Canyon opens in China; cuts travel time from 2 hours to 2 minutes
item.description: China has officially opened the Huajiang Grand Canyon Bridge, now the world's highest at 625 metres, dramatically reducing travel time in Guizhou Province. This 2890-metre marvel, also the largest-span steel truss girder suspension bridge in mountainous terrain, significantly enhances regional connectivity and economic growth. It surpasses the Beipanjiang Bridge, further cementing China's infrastructure prowess, though France's Millau Viaduct remains structurally taller.
